verdict.rationale: Exa ships SDKs, a hosted and open-source MCP server, and a SaaS API, so telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry setting, data-retention control, or tracking opt-out. The robots.txt crawling claim concerns how Exa indexes the web, not tracking of users, so it does not bear on this story.
